name: Nav1.6 + Kv3 co-expression: does Kv3 rescue the DSI loss caused by Nav1.6?
short_description: Test whether co-inserting Kv3 with Nav1.6 on the t0065 soma rescues the direction selectivity that Nav1.6 alone erodes (t0067 DSI = 0.23 at Nav1.6_high). 9 conditions x PD/ND x 5 seeds = 90 FULL trials.
